description: SonarProject is the Schema for the sonarprojects API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: SonarProjectSpec defines the desired state of SonarProject.

key.description:
Key is the SonarQube project key.
This is a unique identifier for the project in SonarQube.
Allowed characters are alphanumeric, '-' (dash), '_' (underscore), '.' (period) and ':' (colon), with at least one non-digit.

mainBranch.description:
MainBranch is the key of the main branch of the project.
If not provided, the default main branch key will be used.

name.description: Name is the display name of the project.

sonarRef.description: SonarRef is a reference to Sonar custom resource.

kind.description: Kind specifies the kind of the Sonar resource.

name.description: Name specifies the name of the Sonar resource.

visibility.description: Visibility defines the visibility of the project.

status.description: SonarProjectStatus defines the observed state of SonarProject.

error.description: Error is an error message if something went wrong.

projectKey.description: ProjectKey is the actual project key in SonarQube.

value.description: Value is a status of the project.
